description: Frontal photograph of a U.S. Air Force B-2 Spirit stealth bomber parked on a ramp in front of a large tan hangar with a U.S. flag banner mounted on it. A B-2 silhouette-and-star emblem is painted on the tarmac in front of the aircraft. The setting is consistent with the Northrop plant at Palmdale, California, where the B-2 was publicly rolled out in 1988.
flags: Palmdale rollout setting inferred from scene, not stated in the image

description: Graphic showing a dense crowd of silhouetted people, seen from behind, walking toward a glowing orange sunburst sky. Large white distressed capital letters across the image read THE GREAT AWAKENING, the QAnon slogan.

Screenshot of an 8chan Q post (tripcode !xowAT4Z3VQ, No.896184, April 4 2018) on a mauve background, with a block of linked reply post numbers at the top. The post replies to >>896069 and tells readers to build a timeline of 'Hussein' (Barack Obama) from 1/20/17 to the present, cross it against POTUS' schedule and White House visitor logs, claiming this will become very relevant soon.

description: Annotated side-by-side compilation. Right: a screenshot of a purported private chat (green diamond avatars, pseudonyms Roger, Dooku, Severus, Huck, dated May 17) discussing 'MF', 'the limey' and a tape. Red boxes and arrows link 'Adam Entous' in the article to the abbreviation 'AEWP' in the chat, implying AEWP means Adam Entous of the Washington Post.

He isn't brightest bulb, but that project has worked perfectly. Roger. May 17 at 2:47pm. It really has. Huck, didn't AEWP mention it when we gave him that tape? Huck. May 17 at 2:47pm.
